'''Water cycs''' were large [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Jellyfish/Legends|jellyfish]]-like predators that floated in the [[Water/Legends|waterways]] of various [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. Never giving pursuit, they lay in wait for their prey, snatching it with their quick poisonous [[Limb/Legends|tentacles]].<ref name="DF2" /> By [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="DF2Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> they populated irrigation tunnels on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]].<ref name="DF2" /> A larger [[Sithspawn/Legends|mutated]] water cyc also lived in the [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]],<ref name="MOTS" /> and in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="MOTSDate">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, we can deduce that ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] encountered them on her [[Mission to Dromund Kaas (New Republic)|mission]] to the [[Dark Force Temple]].<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Water cycs first appeared in the [[1997]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' in the third level on Sulon.<ref name="DF2" />
